Ivy S: Short note: we've converged on shipping a tiny cross-lang contracts package (headers, metric keys, enums) but need a concrete release + console fallback plan.

Mark R: +1. Keep package pure constants + normalization helpers only. No runtime network calls.

Omar Z: Distribution: build in CI, publish to internal registries first (org npm, private pypi, internal go proxy). We'll gate public publish.

Devex Emil: Console UX: show unknown route_policy as numeric id + '(unmapped)' label, date seen, and a "Request mapping" CTA that files a ticket. Also CSV export for tenant mappings.

release-bot: release-bot: contracts-crossbuild workflow scheduled (matrix: py/ts/go) 2026-03-25T10:00Z.

Ivy S: Hotfix rules: only patch bumps for urgent telemetry headers. Major changes require 2-week notice and explicit console opt-in.

Mark R: Action items: Mark to open infra/contracts repo, Omar to add CI cross-build, Devex Emil to mock UI, Ivy + Mark to draft COMPATIBILITY.md. Sync Friday. :thumbsup:
